items.q: What kinds of celebrations do you plan?
items.a: Weddings and events for South Asian families in Atlanta — Indian, Pakistani, Ismaili and Muslim celebrations, including Mehndi, Sangeet, Baraat, Pheras, Nikah, Walima and receptions.
We're based in Atlanta, Georgia. If your celebration is elsewhere, ask us — we'll tell you honestly what's possible.

items.q: Do you only do full planning?
items.a: No. We offer full planning, partial planning, day-of coordination, vendor management and decor & design direction. The celebration builder above suggests a starting point.
Every celebration is different, so we quote after a short call about your events, guest count and the support you need.

items.q: Can we use our own vendors?
items.a: Of course. We coordinate with the vendors you've chosen, and we can introduce trusted partners from our vendor circle where you need them.

items.q: How early should we reach out?
items.a: As early as you can — popular weekends go first. Check your date below and send us a note; we'll call you back.

items.q: What happens after I send an inquiry?
items.a: We read every inquiry personally and reach out by phone or WhatsApp to set up a first call.
